title: Training & Development Manager
description:
TRAINING \& DEVELOPMENT MANAGER
   

  

 Foundry Manufacturing Industry
   

  

**Position:** 
 Training \& Development Manager
   

  

**Department:** 
 Human Resources / Training \& Development
   

  

**Experience:** 
 8–12 Years, preferably in Foundry / Manufacturing Industry
   

  

**Qualification:** 
 MBA / PGDM – HR / Training \& Development / MSW / Relevant Engineering Qualification
   

  

**Location:** 
 Wai Dist\-Satara Maharashtra
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and implement the annual Training \& Development plan based on organizational and departmental requirements.
* Identify Training Needs (TNI/TNA) based on competency gaps, performance, KRA and skill requirements.
* Develop and maintain skill matrix and competency matrices for employees, operators and technicians.
* Design training programs for new employees, existing employees, contract workers and temporary workers.
* Develop skill\-based training modules for Foundry operations such as:
+ Melting \& Furnace Operations
+ Moulding
+ Core Shop
+ Sand Plant
+ Fettling \& Shot Blasting
+ Quality \& Laboratory
+ Maintenance
+ Crane \& Material Handling
+ Gatecutting/Patternshop
+ Safety and Emergency Response

* Establish and monitor OJT, classroom and practical training programs.
* Develop training materials, SOP\-based training modules, work instructions and evaluation questionnaires.
* Conduct skill\-level assessments and competency evaluations for employees.
* Monitor effectiveness of training through post\-training evaluation, skill improvement and workplace performance.
* Maintain complete training records, attendance, assessment results and competency certification.
* Develop and implement L1/L2/L3/L4 skill certification systems as applicable.
* Coordinate with HODs and Section In\-Charges to identify critical skill gaps and improvement areas.
* Promote Kaizen, suggestion schemes, cross\-functional learning and continuous improvement.
* Monitor training KPIs and prepare monthly / quarterly Training MIS reports.
* Support new employee induction and job\-specific orientation programs.
* Ensure training compliance related to quality, safety, environment and customer requirements.
* Support internal / customer audits related to competency and training records.
* Develop internal trainers through a Train\-the\-Trainer (TTT) program.


**Required Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Training Need Identification, Competency Development and Skill Matrix Management.
* Experience in shop\-floor training and operator skill development.
* Good understanding of foundry manufacturing processes will be preferred.
* Knowledge of KRA, KPI, competency assessment and performance management.
* Good presentation and communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical, leadership and people\-management skills.
* Knowledge of 5S, Kaizen, Quality and Safety systems will be an advantage.


 Key Performance Areas
   

  

**Training Effectiveness \| Competency Development \| Skill Matrix \| Training Compliance \| Employee Development \| New Employee Training \| OJT Effectiveness \| Skill Certification \| Training MIS \| Continuous Improvement**
**Preferred Candidate**
 Candidates with experience in
 **Foundry / Automotive / Engineering / Manufacturing Industries** 
 , particularly in
 **shop\-floor skill development and technical training** 
 , will be preferred.
   

  

**Additional Benefits:** 
 PF / Mediclaim / Leave Payment
   

  

**Facility:** 
 Accommodation provided free of cost
   

  

 subsidiary Canteen /Transport facility
